name: Tsui no Sora Remake
source: A remake of Tsui no Sora included in the 10th anniversary Subarashiki Hibi package, including a fully rewritten script that is 1.5 times the size of the original and a "whole new work of its own".
translation: 本作为《终之空》的重制版，收录于《美好的每一天～不连续的存在～》十周年纪念版套装。剧本全部重写，篇幅为原作的1.5倍，堪称“一部全新的独立作品”。
